Zee Cine Award for Best Actor – Male | The Zee Cine Award for Best Actor – Male is chosen by the viewers of Zee Entertainment Enterprises as part of its annual award ceremony for Hindi films, to recognise a male actor who has delivered an outstanding performance in a leading role.  Following its inception in 1998, a ceremony was not held in 2009 and 2010, but resumed back in 2011.  Shah Rukh Khan, with seven awards holds the record of the maximum wins in this category.
